LESSON: READING FOR FLUENCY

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Reading
Topic 2.2: Reading for Fluency
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading for Fluency, part of Reading in Grade 9 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: How can reading fluently enhance our understanding of a text?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen and repeat reading out words on names, ages, professions, and places of work of nuclear and extended family members (学校、医院、商场、派出 所、农场、饭店、老师、医生、警 察、护士、农民、商人、服务员),

2. read short texts and match images of different professions with their places of work and read them out to peers,

3. read along a text related to nuclear and extended family members with appropriate intonation and pronunciation,

4. team up with peers to perform a reader’s theatre,

5. collaborate with peers to form reading groups for peer feedback and support,

6. search online /offline different professions and share with peers those they would love to pursue giving reasons for their choice.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen and repeat reading out words on names, ages, professions, and places of work of nuclear and extended family members (学校、医院、商场、派出 所、农场、饭店、老师、医生、警 察、护士、农民、商人、服务员),
2. read short texts and match images of different professions with their places of work and read them out to peers,
3. read along a text related to nuclear and extended family members with appropriate intonation and pronunciation,
4. team up with peers to perform a reader’s theatre,
5. collaborate with peers to form reading groups for peer feedback and support,
6. search online /offline different professions and share with peers those they would love to pursue giving reasons for their choice.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading for Fluency together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs
